question: Calibrate a dynamic continuation envelope without conditioning on successful jumps

envelope_rule: For each absolute roll,pitch,yaw,world-y,vx-1.5 feature:1.2 times CALIB-window maximum, with floors[1deg,1deg,1deg,0.02m,0.1m/s]; report coverage of untouched HOLDOUT. Do not adopt if any CALIB terminates before5.5s, violates corridor, or bounds exceed original hard constraints.
stop: 25min wall timeout or evaluator exception; no automatic extension
resources: 24lane batched GPU evaluation; user authorized small parallel evaluations
interpretation: Empirical nominal envelope, not a viability set. Original task goal is deliberately outside run; goal success and calibrated continuation are separate.
contact_gate: Use recorded400Hz contact modes and original256contact buffer; known-ground contact must register. No new multimap configuration.
